title: Latch a Snapware Pyrex leftovers container
instruction: Put the lid on the glass leftovers container. Press down on the lid while closing all four tabs, then let go.
context: Closing the container requires seating a loose lid, bracing it against the glass rim and pressing each tab beneath the lip.
setup: A transparent rounded 147 mm-rim glass vessel. The lid starts off the container on a separate rest, all four tabs at −57°. A removable silicone lift grip sits at the center.
scoring: 0.25 for seating within 4 mm laterally and −3 to +4 mm vertically with level aligned lid. Each latch contributes 0.15 when it closes within 7° of its stop and its measured catch overlaps the underside of the rim. Full score after all four are engaged, with a stable lid and no robot contact for 1 s.
reset_notes: Return lid to its side rest, put all four tabs at the open stop, and keep the glass vessel on its nonslip mat.
fidelity: Transparent glass and four latch geometry follow Snapware 1109304. A removable low silicone grip allows lid transfer. Hinges and gasket compression are approximations. The scorer measures mechanical closure and stability over all four tabs.
